# Parameters

*Generated by `tee-schema --markdown` from the simulator's Spec: do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `build-dev/bin/tee-schema --markdown --out docs/manual/parameters.md`. Settings with no help sentence yet have one proposed in [help.tsv](help.tsv).*
